name: TransThera Sciences (Nanjing). Inc.
summary: TransThera Sciences (Nanjing), Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firm that finds, develops and commercialises small-molecule drugs for cancer, inflammatory and cardiometabolic conditions. Candidates include Tinengotinib (TT-00420) for drug-resistant solid tumors, TT-00973, a cancer kinase inhibitor, and TT-01488, a BTK inhibitor.
